h1: Custom Blue Vests for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Order custom blue vests for your team or event. Bulk pricing on embroidered soft shell, puffer, and fleece vests at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Blue vests offer a professional, unified look for corporate teams, safety crews, and event staff. From lightweight soft shell vests for outdoor trade shows to insulated puffer vests for cold-weather branding, blue provides a versatile base that pairs well with most logo colors. Choose from navy or royal shades to match your company palette. Embroidered or screen-printed logos ensure your brand stands out on job sites or at company outings.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom blue vests with embroidered logos at a corporate event
